programs.title: Emma Fielding Mysteries
programs.desc: Archaeologist Emma Fielding unearths evidence of a 17th-century coastal Maine settlement that predates Jamestown, but the dead body that accompanies it embroils Emma and her students in a different kind of investigation.

programs.title: Shifting Gears
programs.desc: Motor City mechanic Jess reluctantly agrees to participate in a car restoration show and is shocked to learn that her ex-boyfriend, Luke, is her main competitor.

programs.title: The Manny
programs.desc: Morgan stalks his way into the lives of busy social media influencer Lani and her son, Jaylen, to become their male nanny; as Morgan shows himself to be someone who is too good to be true, he meddles with Lani and Jaylen's lives.

programs.title: Octopussy
programs.desc: James Bond (Roger Moore) may have met his match in Octopussy (Maud Adams), an entrancing beauty involved in a devastating military plot to destroy détente. From the palaces of India to a speeding circus train in Germany and a midair battle on the wing of a high-flying jet, only Agent 007 can stop the nightmarish scheme!

programs.title: Dark Side of the 90s
programs.desc: In the '90s, parents and kids bonded over collecting playful plush toys known as Beanie Babies until the toy's creator, Ty Warner, used the internet's power to create a frenzied market.

programs.title: Sullivan's Crossing
programs.desc: Maggie's medical training is put to the test as she races against the clock to save the life of a friend.
